repo_notes.content: Jekyll 4 plugin (Ruby >= 3.3): per-site :site, :post_write cache busting for supported local URL attributes in generated .html/.htm. Priority defaults to 12 and is configurable from 11 through 19.

Architecture: HtmlTagScanner + HtmlTagParser find exact source spans, skipping comments and raw-text contents; Rewriter transforms src/href/xlink:href/srcset/poster; SrcsetRewriter preserves data URLs; UrlTagger resolves and confines targets; Hasher computes content MD5 with a build-local memo.

Design invariants: ?v=<md5(content)[0,10]> is derived from output bytes; hash each path once per build, never persist metadata-keyed digests; reject traversal and symlink targets outside site.dest; skip symlinked HTML outputs; preserve source bytes except changed attribute values.

Scope: HTML attribute URLs only. CSS url()/@import, inline CSS, JavaScript runtime fetch/import, and JSON/XML references are not rewritten. CSS and compressor plugin integration is described in README; `fingerprint_flow.priority` defaults to 12 (11..19); the pipeline is normal processing 20 -> fingerprint -> compression 10.
See AGENTS.md / README.md for config, supported attributes, limitations, gates (rubocop/rspec/semgrep/bundler-audit), and the trusted-publishing release workflow.
